column1: # TF family map. Columns: pfam_acc, family, paper_family, note.
# family = BFD family label (the tf_family text of nextflow/assets/fungal_tf_pfam_domains.csv for the existing Pfams; short names for the added ones).
# paper_family = row name in Lax et al. 2025 MOESM3 sheet 'TF count' (trailing spaces in the sheet removed).
# Rows with an empty pfam_acc are not counted. They list what is unmapped: paper families without a Pfam here, and listed Pfams that have no hits and no entry in pfam_names.
# Counting source: Pfams in tf_inventory come from tf_inventory; the added ones come from pfam.parquet. Domain gate: see bin/summary/build_tf_tables.py.
